models._description: Payment Token (saved Razorpay card/UPI eMandate; provider_ref = 'customer_id,token_id')

security.note: No own ACL/rules; relies on payment's security and on base.group_system field groups guarding razorpay_key_secret, razorpay_webhook_secret and all OAuth-token fields (account_id/refresh/public/access tokens + expiry).

views.note: No own model views; xml_loc=132 is view inheritance (payment.provider form: razorpay_key_id + 'Connect'/OAuth onboarding button + 'Generate Webhook' action), QWeb templates (payment_razorpay_templates.xml inline form + authorization_error page), and data/payment_provider_data.xml (the Razorpay payment.provider + payment.method records).

behavioral_notes.observation: On a first online_direct/validation payment, _get_specific_processing_values POSTs 'customers' (name/email/contact) then 'orders' (_razorpay_create_order -> _razorpay_prepare_order_payload: amount in minor units via payment_utils.to_minor_currency_units, currency, method=payment-method code unless in const.FALLBACK_PAYMENT_METHOD_CODES, customer_id, and for tokenize a 'token' block with max_amount/expire_at[+10y]/frequency='as_presented') and returns razorpay_key_id + razorpay_order_id + razorpay_customer_id to the browser Razorpay Checkout SDK. All outbound HTTP is delegated to payment.provider._send_api_request, which payment_razorpay points at https://api.razorpay.com/{api_version}/{endpoint} (default v1) via _build_request_url and authenticates with HTTP Basic (razorpay_key_id, razorpay_key_secret) in _build_request_auth -- OR, when OAuth is configured (access token, no key_id), an 'Authorization: Bearer <razorpay_access_token>' header built in _build_request_headers that auto-refreshes via _razorpay_refresh_access_token when expired. capture_manually adds a payment.capture='manual' block (manual_expiry_period 7200, refund_speed normal). None of this server-to-server HTTP is visible in Python field/model metadata.

_send_payment_request (operation online_token/offline) first guards against a duplicate token charge for the same document within 36 hours (RBI 24h-processing window, searching pending same-prefix txs), then creates an Order and POSTs 'payments/create/recurring' with email/contact/amount/order_id/customer_id/token (token_id split from token_id.provider_ref 'customer_id,token_id') and recurring='1', folding the response into payment's state machine via _process('razorpay', ...). _send_capture_request POSTs 'payments/<provider_reference>/capture' (full only -- support_manual_capture='full_only'); _send_refund_request POSTs 'payments/<provider_reference>/refund' (partial supported, negative amount, notes.reference for webhook correlation) and tags entity_type='refund'; _send_void_request raises UserError -- Razorpay transactions cannot be voided from Odoo. _apply_updates maps Razorpay status (const.PAYMENT_STATUS_MAPPING created/authorized/captured/failed) onto _set_pending/_set_authorized/_set_done/_set_error, fetching full payment data with GET 'payments/<id>' when only a redirect razorpay_payment_id is available. These cross-system calls and the state transitions are invisible to metadata.

behavioral_notes.element: RazorpayController.razorpay_webhook (/payment/razorpay/webhook) + razorpay_return_from_checkout (/payment/razorpay/return) -> HMAC-SHA256 signature verification + tx state update
behavioral_notes.observation: The public, csrf=False POST webhook at /payment/razorpay/webhook parses the JSON event; for events in const.HANDLED_WEBHOOK_EVENTS (payment.authorized, payment.captured, payment.failed, refund.failed, refund.processed) it extracts the payment/refund entity, locates the tx via payment.transaction._search_by_reference (by the payment's 'description'=Odoo reference, or for refunds by notes.reference, else by provider_reference creating a child refund tx) and calls _verify_signature BEFORE acting. _verify_signature (controllers/main.py) reads the X-Razorpay-Signature header, rejects a missing signature with werkzeug Forbidden, then HMAC-SHA256s the raw body with razorpay_webhook_secret (_razorpay_calculate_signature is_redirect=False) and compares with hmac.compare_digest (constant-time). The redirect-return route /payment/razorpay/return (save_session=False) instead signs '<razorpay_order_id>|<razorpay_payment_id>' with razorpay_key_secret (is_redirect=True) before _process and redirect to /payment/status. Signature trust, constant-time compare, and inbound state transition are all invisible to metadata.

behavioral_notes.element: OAuth self-onboarding via Odoo proxy (action_start_onboarding / RazorpayController.razorpay_return_from_authorization / _razorpay_refresh_access_token) + action_razorpay_create_webhook
behavioral_notes.observation: action_start_onboarding (override of payment) gates on const.SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES (RedirectWarning if the company currency is unsupported), then redirects to the Razorpay OAuth authorize URL ({OAUTH_URL}/authorize) carrying a return_url, provider_id and CSRF token. Razorpay sends the merchant back to /payment/razorpay/oauth/return (auth=user, website=True); the controller validates the CSRF token (Forbidden on failure), then POSTs '/get_access_token' through Odoo's Razorpay proxy at https://razorpay.api.odoo.com/api/razorpay/1 (is_proxy_request=True, payload wrapped by _prepare_json_rpc_payload), stores razorpay_account_id + public/refresh/access tokens (+expiry), clears the classical key fields, sets state=enabled/is_published, and auto-registers the webhook. action_razorpay_create_webhook mints a random secret, POSTs 'accounts/<account_id>/webhooks' (api_version=v2) with const.HANDLED_WEBHOOK_EVENTS, and stores the returned signing secret. _razorpay_refresh_access_token re-mints the access token via the proxy '/refresh_access_token' when expired. A @api.constrains forbids enabling a provider without either an OAuth account_id or both key_id+key_secret.

behavioral_notes.element: tokenization / eMandate for saved cards & UPI (recurring) (_extract_token_values / _razorpay_get_mandate_max_amount / payment.token._razorpay_get_limit_exceed_warning)
behavioral_notes.observation: When tx.tokenize is set (or a token_id is returned provider-side and provider.allow_tokenization), the order payload carries an eMandate 'token' block and _extract_token_values vaults a payment.token: payment_details = card last4 or UPI vpa tail or the pm code, and provider_ref = '<customer_id>,<token_id>' (both Razorpay ids needed for later recurring charges). _razorpay_get_mandate_max_amount caps the mandate using const.MANDATE_MAX_AMOUNT (card 1,000,000 INR / upi 100,000 INR), converted from INR via _razorpay_convert_inr_to_currency and bounded by the linked document's amount*1.5 / MRR*5. payment.token._razorpay_get_limit_exceed_warning surfaces a portal warning when a token charge would exceed that mandate cap. Subsequent off-session charges go through _send_payment_request -> payments/create/recurring. This Indian recurring-mandate flow (RBI rules) is entirely in code, invisible to metadata.

behavioral_notes.element: external integration surface (gap #7) -- endpoints, keys, SDK
behavioral_notes.observation: Static gap-#7 facts (extract_frontend.py): uses_api_keys=true; two outbound endpoints -- https://api.razorpay.com/{api_version}/{endpoint} (direct REST, HTTP Basic key_id/key_secret OR OAuth Bearer access-token auth) and https://razorpay.api.odoo.com/api/razorpay/1 (Odoo's Razorpay OAuth proxy, jsonrpc) -- declared in const.py and models/payment_provider.py. No 'requests' import here: HTTP is delegated to payment.provider._send_api_request in the parent engine, which payment_razorpay configures via the _build_request_url / _build_request_headers / _build_request_auth / _parse_response_* hook overrides. On the browser side the Razorpay Checkout SDK is opened on the payment-form page (PaymentForm.prototype patch) -- a second, client-side channel to Razorpay. This dual server-to-server + client-side acquirer link is the canonical metadata gap #7: none of it is reachable from model/field metadata.

behavioral_notes.element: frontend (static) -- Razorpay Checkout inline form patch
behavioral_notes.observation: 1 JS file, 0 OWL components, 0 registry adds (gap #3). The module patches the shared PaymentForm.prototype (static/src/interactions/payment_form.js) rather than registering a new component: it consumes the inline-form processing values from payment.transaction._get_specific_processing_values (razorpay_key_id, razorpay_public_token, razorpay_customer_id, razorpay_order_id, is_tokenize_request, optional callback_url) to open the Razorpay Checkout SDK in the browser and drive the card/UPI/netbanking/wallet payment. Assets load into web.assets_frontend (manifest entry payment_razorpay/static/src/interactions/payment_form.js). This browser interaction and the Razorpay Checkout SDK are invisible to Python metadata (gap #3).

external_integrations.sdk: Razorpay Checkout (browser SDK); server side uses no python SDK -- HTTP via payment.provider._send_api_request
external_integrations.auth: HTTP Basic (razorpay_key_id, razorpay_key_secret) OR OAuth Bearer <razorpay_access_token> (direct API); Odoo jsonrpc proxy (OAuth onboarding)
external_integrations.pattern: Concrete realization of metadata gap #7: a real external acquirer integration for the Indian market. Outbound server-to-server REST to api.razorpay.com (Customers / Orders / Payments / recurring / capture / refund / webhooks) authenticated with an API key pair (HTTP Basic) or OAuth Bearer token; merchant OAuth self-onboarding routed through Odoo's razorpay.api.odoo.com proxy; a parallel client-side Razorpay Checkout SDK channel; and inbound settlement via an X-Razorpay-Signature-verified webhook plus a redirect-return route. The base 'payment' engine flags uses_api_keys but ships no live acquirer -- this module is exactly that override.
external_integrations.note: Prime gap-#7 example: none of the Razorpay endpoints, the Basic/OAuth auth, the webhook HMAC trust, or the browser Checkout SDK channel are derivable from Python model/field metadata; they were established only by reading const.py + the model/controller code.

classification.apqc_category: 9.0 Manage Financial Resources (9.5 process payments / collect cash; manage external payment provider)
classification.rationale: payment_razorpay is a value-NETWORK (Stabell & Fjeldstad mediating-technology) component: a concrete acquirer adapter whose purpose is to interconnect two parties who would not otherwise transact directly -- the cardholder/UPI payer and the merchant -- by linking the merchant to Razorpay's card/UPI/netbanking/wallet network for the Indian market. It exhibits the three mediating-technology activities: network promotion & contract management (Razorpay OAuth self-onboarding, automatic webhook registration, key/token management, eMandate setup), service provisioning (creating the Customer/Order and capturing/refunding per transaction), and infrastructure operation (the server-to-server api.razorpay.com link, the Razorpay Checkout client channel, and the signed-webhook settlement loop). It does not transform inputs into outputs (chain) nor solve a bespoke customer problem (shop). It inherits the parent 'payment' engine's value_model exactly: the engine is the generic mediator and this module is its Razorpay realization. activity_class is 'support' because, from the enterprise value-chain perspective, payment acceptance is an infrastructure/finance support function (category Accounting/Payment Providers, application=False, no end-user app) sitting under 9.0 Manage Financial Resources -- specifically 9.5 process payments / collect cash, with the side of 'manage an external payment provider'. So value_model=network (its own internal logic is mediation, an acquirer integration -- gap #7), activity_class=support (its place on the enterprise value chain). This mirrors the sibling payment_stripe.metamodel.json (network/support) and the parent payment engine, and contrasts with account_payment (support/support), whose own logic is ledger record-keeping rather than mediation.

voiding a Razorpay transaction from Odoo is explicitly unsupported (_send_void_request raises UserError)

eMandate caps are pinned in const.MANDATE_MAX_AMOUNT (card/upi); other methods fall back to defaults
bespoke reconciliation / settlement document chains live downstream (account_payment, sale), not here
